source_text: Sara vere soror de patre, non de matre; et uxor. Prophetia Abrahae orat pro gentibus. Ecclesia et soror et sponsa.
pass_a_gloss: Sarah truly sister from father, not from mother; and wife. Prophecy of-Abraham prays for nations. Church both sister and bride.
pass_b_english: Sarah is truly [[sister by the father, not by the mother >> Bible:Genesis 20:12]]; and wife. Abraham the prophet prays for the nations. The church is both sister and bride.
